# Kofi Note On The Early Shift Pattern

Kofi gave me this on paper on 2026-10-02, two days after the second-site review. Filed with his permission; my summary, with his phrasing where it matters.

- The early shift works because three people know the whole sequence. Adding a second site's bread means either a longer shift or a second, earlier one.
- A 03:00 start is not a small change. It means going to bed at 19:00 and missing evenings for good. He did it at a previous job for two years and will not do it again.
- If central production happens, he would want: a separate night baker or two, the Hollowgate bake left as it is, and the extra bread planned by someone other than him.
- He is not against growth. "Don't build it on the same three people."
- On the current pattern: Fridays are still too long; ordering could move to me.

I have put his conditions into the [[central-production-kitchen]] questions for the 2026-12-15 decision and into [[can-we-get-the-head-baker-under-42-hours]].
